newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Parent mulls sales of HK Toy Centre stake.
newsitem.headline: Parent mulls sales of HK Toy Centre stake.

text.p: Hong Kong Toy Centre International Ltd said its controlling shareholders Victor Lo and Esther Leung were in talks to sell their holding in the company.
The toy maker said its chairman Lo and exeuctive director Leung had been "approached by an independent third party in relation to a possible acquisition of the company's shares held by them."
"Negotiations as regards such sale of shares in the company are still in progress and such sale and purchase may or may not materialize," the company said in the statement.
Lo and Leung held about 47 percent of the company as in September 1996.
The company shares jumped HK$0.19 or 36.54 percent to an intraday high of HK$0.71 in late trade on Wednesday.
Volume was 25.63 million shares worth HK$16.24 million.
